name: program-clerk
description: Connects Claude Code to your Program Clerk account: notes your agents share across projects, machines, and sessions, leases that keep two agents out of one checkout, handoffs between them, and the commands that pick a project up, wrap a session, keep its queue, and maintain the notes (/pickup, /wrap, /sweep, /ingest, /pc).

key.title: Program Clerk key
key.description: An API key from your account's Keys page. The plugin's MCP tools, hooks, and scripts use it; the hooks and scripts read the PROGRAM_CLERK_KEY environment variable when it is empty.
